phase_1.title: Phase 1 · FN FAL 50.00 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×51mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 415 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 415 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 533 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 840 m/s (3350 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Bolt Tilt Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, carrier cam ramps lift the tilting bolt tail clear of the receiver locking shoulder for extraction.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the FN FAL 50.00 staged for its 650–700 RPM cyclic (often issued semi-auto) cadence.

zh.headline: FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪：1953 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 迪厄多内·塞夫（Dieudonné Saive）主持设计的 FN FAL 是冷战时期最具全球影响力的 7.62mm 全威力战斗步枪：凭借精细多档可调导气阀、尾部下倾闭锁楔块与铰接式快速分解机匣，先后装备超过 90 个国家。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：FN FAL 50.00 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1953 年问世的 FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪 由比利时比利时赫斯塔尔国家兵工厂（FN Herstal）主导研制，定位为经典的自动战斗步枪。FAL 原计划发射英国 .280 中间威力弹，因北约口径标准化改膛为 7.62×51mm NATO，并衍生出公制与英联邦英制（L1A1 SLR）两大工业体系。
迪厄多内·塞夫（Dieudonné Saive）主持设计的 FN FAL 是冷战时期最具全球影响力的 7.62mm 全威力战斗步枪：凭借精细多档可调导气阀、尾部下倾闭锁楔块与铰接式快速分解机匣，先后装备超过 90 个国家。 整件装备总长 1,090 mm（标准 21 in 枪管）、空重 4.3 kg，成为同期自动步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1953 年，比利时比利时赫斯塔尔国家兵工厂（FN Herstal）推出了划时代的FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪。FAL 原计划发射英国 .280 中间威力弹，因北约口径标准化改膛为 7.62×51mm NATO，并衍生出公制与英联邦英制（L1A1 SLR）两大工业体系。 它的核心设计聚焦于枪机尾部下沉卡入机匣闭锁肩的偏移闭锁机构，加工简洁且耐污能力强，奠定了其在自动步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「7 档可调短行程导气活塞 · 下倾偏移闭锁枪机（Tilting Bolt）」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，导气机框斜面抬起闭锁块尾部脱离机匣闭锁肩，实现直线抽壳抛壳，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用高温发蓝锻造合金钢精加工而成。前端 7 档旋转式燃气调节套环可随弹药威力和积碳工况精细校准导气量，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪 采用7 档可调短行程导气活塞 · 下倾偏移闭锁枪机（Tilting Bolt）。在每个击发周期中，导气机框斜面抬起闭锁块尾部脱离机匣闭锁肩，实现直线抽壳抛壳。借助高温发蓝锻造合金钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了前端 7 档旋转式燃气调节套环可随弹药威力和积碳工况精细校准导气量。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×51mm NATO 弹药规格与 533 mm 镀铬枪管（4 条右旋膛线 · 305 mm / 1:12 缠距），最高工作膛压约 415 MPa，可赋予弹头 840 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,350 J 动能，有效作用距离达 600 米。
内膛技术特点方面，533 mm 长身管完整释放 7.62×51mm NATO 全威力弹 3,350 J 动能。同时，机匣铰接分解结构按下锁扣即可像折管猎枪般一秒打开抽取枪机组，令其在 650–700 发/分（多国列装限半自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 533 毫米身管与 7.62×51mm NATO 口径，FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪 实现了每秒 840 米的初速与 600 米有效射程。533 mm 长身管完整释放 7.62×51mm NATO 全威力弹 3,350 J 动能，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 39 mm 膛轴设计，FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 10.6 N·s 水平。非随动左侧折叠拉机柄与重心折叠提把带来极其顺手的战地携行体验。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-39）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，非随动左侧折叠拉机柄与重心折叠提把带来极其顺手的战地携行体验。欢迎在 BAY-39 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: FN FAL 50.00: The 1953 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Designed by Dieudonné Saive, the FN FAL dominated Cold War 7.62mm battle rifle doctrine across more than 90 nations through its fine-tunable gas regulator, rear-dropping tilting breechblock, and break-open hinged receiver. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-39.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the FN FAL 50.00
paragraphs: Introduced in 1953 by FN Herstal in Belgium, the FN FAL 50.00 emerged as a defining Battle Rifle. Originally prototyped in .280 British before NATO standardized on 7.62×51mm, the FAL split into both metric and Commonwealth inch-pattern (L1A1 SLR) production lines worldwide.

Designed by Dieudonné Saive, the FN FAL dominated Cold War 7.62mm battle rifle doctrine across more than 90 nations through its fine-tunable gas regulator, rear-dropping tilting breechblock, and break-open hinged receiver. Measuring 1,090 mm (Standard 21 in Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 4.3 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1953, FN Herstal of Belgium introduced the FN FAL 50.00. Originally prototyped in .280 British before NATO standardized on 7.62×51mm, the FAL split into both metric and Commonwealth inch-pattern (L1A1 SLR) production lines worldwide. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Rear-dropping tilting breechblock locks into a solid receiver shoulder with minimal machining complexity — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the FN FAL 50.00 sits its 7-Position Adjustable Short-Stroke Gas Piston · Rear-Drop Tilting Breechblock. Throughout every firing cycle, carrier cam ramps lift the tilting bolt tail clear of the receiver locking shoulder for extraction, containing 415 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hot-salt blued forged alloy steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Adjustable front gas-exhaust collar tunes piston impulse for fouled or varied-pressure ammo, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The FN FAL 50.00 relies on 7-Position Adjustable Short-Stroke Gas Piston · Rear-Drop Tilting Breechblock. During each cycle, carrier cam ramps lift the tilting bolt tail clear of the receiver locking shoulder for extraction. Machined from hot-salt blued forged alloy steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Adjustable front gas-exhaust collar tunes piston impulse for fouled or varied-pressure ammo.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×51mm NATO with 533 mm Chrome-Lined Barrel (4-Groove RH · 1:12" / 305 mm Twist), the FN FAL 50.00 develops 840 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,350 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 600 meters.

Internally, Full 533 mm barrel burns 7.62×51mm NATO completely to yield 3,350 J muzzle energy. Combined with its 650–700 RPM cyclic (often issued semi-auto) tempo, Hinged break-open receiver pivots apart like a shotgun for rapid field maintenance, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×51mm NATO through its 533 millimeter bore, the FN FAL 50.00 achieves 840 meters per second and 600 meters of effective reach. Full 533 mm barrel burns 7.62×51mm NATO completely to yield 3,350 J muzzle energy.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with a 39 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 10.6 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Non-reciprocating left-side charging handle and balance-point carry handle optimize handling.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-39), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, Non-reciprocating left-side charging handle and balance-point carry handle optimize handling. Explore BAY-39 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the FN FAL 50.00.

zh.craftAndMaterial: 采用高温发蓝锻造合金钢制造，表面按1953年代比利时赫斯塔尔国家兵工厂（FN Herstal）军械标准精整，兼顾耐磨与防蚀。
zh.kinematicRole: 在击发循环中承担核心联动：导气机框斜面抬起闭锁块尾部脱离机匣闭锁肩，实现直线抽壳抛壳。

zh.audioScript: U-04，枪机框与拉机操作传动组。作为 FN FAL 50.00 战斗步枪 的关键构件，它采用高温发蓝锻造合金钢制造，主要承担驱动解锁、后坐与复位循环职能。在击发循环中承担核心联动：导气机框斜面抬起闭锁块尾部脱离机匣闭锁肩，实现直线抽壳抛壳。

en.kinematicRole: Drives the core operating sequence: carrier cam ramps lift the tilting bolt tail clear of the receiver locking shoulder for extraction.
en.designHighlight: Integrated directly with the platform's defining strength: Non-reciprocating left-side charging handle and balance-point carry handle optimize handling.
en.audioScript: U-04, Bolt Carrier & Operating Group. Crafted from hot-salt blued forged alloy steel for the FN FAL 50.00, this component handles primary cycling actuator.
